args.reason: Persist the three Git integration points discussed for the lighter Restate + Tekton + Argo CD factory stack.

facts.v: Git touchpoints for the lighter Restate factory stack: agents write Git; Tekton and Argo CD only read/sync.
Restate + Tekton + Argo CD on Kubernetes
Factory loop (Restate activities) opens a PR or pushes desired manifests / DeploymentRequest referencing a commit; agents change the cluster via Git, not cluster-admin apply.
Tekton pipelines clone the app repo at a SHA for build and test; Git is the source of truth for what gets built.
Argo CD watches the GitOps repo and/or CR pointing at it, syncs, and reports status; the loop waits on sync status instead of kubectl durability.
